entry.title: Slime Rancher 2 v0.13.0
entry.content: ## New Features - New Goal option: Prisma Shard Hunt - General purpose MacGuffin hunt goal option - Collect the desired number of Prisma Shards and then clear the Prismacore encounter to win - For the Prismacore encounter, all Harmonizers will automatically activate to accelerate your trip to the end of the game. You'll still need the Water Tank to beat the fight. - New Settings: - `randomize_fabricator` - Allows you to turn off Fabricator location checks and make the upgrades vanilla - `randomize_shadow_doors` - Either adds Shadow Plort doors/dispensers to the pool with the `locations` option or eliminates them entirely with the `disabled` option - `shadow_plort_requirement` - Modifies the amount of shadow plorts needed for doors/dispensers to speed up (or slow down) progress through the Grey Labyrinth - `item_notifications` - Allows you to customize what incoming items pop up on the in-game UI ## Quality of Life - In-Game UI notifications on incoming items - Now it's easier to see when you get important items! - Added clearer messaging and teleport guardrails if you find yourself in the wrong zone or in a softlocked position post-teleport ## Logic Fixes - Flutter and Puddle Slimes now correctly require the Jetpack to access - This also applies to their plorts and radiant variants - Fixed region access requirements for Treasure Pods in Rainbow Fields that required activating the 2nd teleporters in Ember Valley and Starlight Strand - Correctly classified the `Progressive Water Tank` as a Progression item ## Bug Fixes - Refactored how offline checks/progress/repairs work - This should address situations where being disconnected from the AP server would leave games in a desynced state between client and server when it comes to upgrades. It also makes offline progress still work from a check perspective, but items won't be granted until reconnection. - Upgrades will now persist locally, meaning progress can still be made even if you're unable to connect to the server when loading the save file

entry.title: Haste v0.5.1
entry.content:
The first revision to the fifth major release of the Haste Archipelago
You will need to subscribe to and enable the [Mod](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3462307025) on Steam.
## Logic Changes - The Triangular Distribution for Fragmentsanity can **no longer** be enabled with Dynamic Per-Shard Fragmentsanity, due to an emerging concern over seeds taking dozens of hours to finish a single late-game Shard's worth of fragment clears if the scaling was high enough - Triangular Distribution can still be used with Static Per-Shard and Global Fragmentsanities, and Balanced Triangular is unaffected - This restriction may be revisited at a later time, due to Triangular being a "landmine" setting that can catastrophically blow up expected seed times with certain combinations of settings - As an example: - With the maximum Dynamic Scaling of 200%, there would be **66** checks in Disaster Shard 2 (and onward), and would require **2211 Fragment clears** to attain - At a *generously* estimated 40 seconds per Fragment, it would roughly **24.5 hours** to complete *just* D2's Fragmentsanity checks - With the same scaling, Shard 1's 26 checks would take **3.9 hours** to complete - In total, from Shard 1 to D2, it would take at best **~120 hours** to do all 482 checks - **This is an unreasonable ask in basically any scenario** - However, at 100% scaling, it would take **30 hours** to complete its 241 checks. This is still a large value, but could hypothetically be playable in long asyncs
## Bugfixes - Fixed Shopsanity Scaling accidentally using Fragmentsanity Scaling's value in the slot data

entry.title: PAYDAY 2: Criminal Dawn v1.0.4r3
entry.content:
A continuous problem has been that the timing on White House is somewhat unfair and very tight, however in all my testing I tend to get Crude Awakening as the final heist instead so I was never really able to experience how rough it could be for myself. After replaying White House a couple times now (not in Criminal Dawn, just generally) I've realised that, yeah. White House *is* a lot longer than I previously thought it was - a well executed loud playthrough can take 20 minutes minimum.
Because I kept getting Crude Awakening in testing, a lot of the timer balance was tailored around *that* heist instead - the issue with this is Crude Awakening can be easily completed in about *ten* minutes, half the time of White House. This creates a huge time gap, and makes White House incredibly unfair to get as the final heist, which is why a lot of people have (rightfully!!) complained about it.
All this is to say White House now benefits from Objectivity when it's chosen as the final heist, *but* you only receive 50% of the bonus instead of the entire bonus. If you have 60% objective speed, you will get 30% on White House. 90% objective speed, you get 45% on White House - etc.
_No APWorld changes since v1.0.4._

entry.content:
### Fixed - Non-Linear Mode: the `chapter7_requirement` option was enforced only by the client against real in-game battle wins, invisible to Archipelago's own logic. entry.title: The Legend of Spyro: Dawn of the Dragon v0.2.0
entry.content: ## Additions: - Elements can now be shuffled into the item pool (excluding Fire and Poison, which the game selects on level load by default) - Added options to handle how elements are added to the item pool for both Spyro and Cynder - The ability to climb walls can now be shuffled into the item pool - The ability to run on walls can now be shuffled into the item pool - Elite enemy mask elements can now be randomized - Objectives are now location checks - The client now has a new icon courtesy of wheezingteapot ## Changes: - Health Gem S/Mana Gem S items have been renamed to Small Health Gem/Small Mana Gem - All instances of the French "Remparts" in the location names have been changed to the English "Ramparts" ## Fixes: - Issues with Death Link's implementation have been fixed. - Small Health Gems and Small Mana Gems are now clamped to Spyro's and Cynder's respective current maximum capacties for those resources. - Catacombs lock/unlock state is not reset by accident after pressing New Game/Load Game - Reconnecting to the multiworld no longer gives excess EXP from out of nowhere ## Known Bugs: - Patches are lost when rebooting the game (#14) - Client always writes patches and items to memory when connecting to Archipelago regardless of game version (#13)
